description: Keys added, changed or removed in one dataset since a feed position, one page at a time with `next_cursor`. Every response's `meta.position` says how far into the change log its data goes. Changes are kept 90 days; an unknown or too-old position answers 404 `since_unknown` or 409 `full_copy_required`, and those errors carry the full copy-and-catch-up rules. Requires a valid key. Costs 0 credits. This carries no figures. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess). A figure can change or disappear when a later filing arrives; figures are not versioned. Read `adjustments` for extractor decisions beyond copying one filed figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.
name: get_changes
title: What changed since
